Name: Lemur Pet
Author: Retrojones81
Description:
[size=4][b]Lemur Pet[/b][/size]

Adds a [b]ring-tailed lemur[/b] as a new kind of pet. It's the same size as a cat and does everything a cat does: wanders the farm, naps on your bed, sits, licks its paws, curls up to sleep, and brings you gifts. And it has a long black-and-white striped tail!

[b]Getting a lemur[/b]
[list]
[*][b]New farm:[/b] on the character creation screen, click the arrows next to the pet until you see the lemur.[/*]
[*][b]Existing farm:[/b] Marnie sells pets once your first pet loves you (max hearts), or from year 2 if you don't have a pet. Talk to Marnie and choose [i]Adopt[/i]. The lemur costs 40,000g, like her other pets.[/*]
[*][b]Right away, for free:[/b] type [font=Courier New]lemur_adopt[/font] in the SMAPI console window while playing.[/*]
[/list]Each pet needs its own pet bowl to go outside. A new pet without a free bowl stays in the farmhouse until you build one (Robin sells them).

[b]Hats[/b]
Lemurs can wear hats just like cats and dogs. Hold a hat and click your lemur.

[b]Install[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url].[/*]
[*]Unzip this mod into your [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font] folder.[/*]
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Compatibility[/b]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6.14+ with SMAPI 4.0+.[/*]
[*]Should work with most mods. Cat retextures don't affect the lemur.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Uninstall[/b]
Delete the [font=Courier New]Mods/LemurPet[/font] folder. If your farm still has a lemur, it will look like a dog without the mod, so keep the mod installed while you have one.

[b]Credits[/b]
The lemur sprites were made by editing the game's cat sprites by ConcernedApe.
